purpose: Independent college scoring projections and strictly separated experimental paper recommendations. No claim of profitable betting readiness.
data: ESPN FBS and FCS final regular-season scores with numeric team IDs, exact kickoff, and known neutral-site flag. Current rankings, winner flags, news, current injuries and future results are never features.
model: Ridge-regression team offense and opponent defense plus league intercept and learned home advantage. Two scoring observations per game. Current and previous season only. Previous-season observations weighted 0.65; calendar recency decay. Minimum six prior games for each team. Predictions exclude observations less than 12 hours before the as-of cutoff.

development.criterion: Mean of spread-margin RMSE and total RMSE, on the same eligible games; fixed tie order listed. No 2025 outcomes before configuration lock.

holdout.method: Chronological UTC-calendar-day refits with only earlier results. No changes to formula or hyperparameters after the configuration lock. Report margin and total MAE/RMSE, naive team-score baseline and game counts including exclusions.

oddsAudit.eligibility: Same Central calendar date; kickoff after snapshot; exact verified team IDs and season; fresh timestamped quotes; FanDuel or BetMGM only. Freeze forecasts and selected exact prices before grading. Keep all misses and REVIEW rows. No alternative dates if results disappoint.

paperSelection.uncertainty: Empirical out-of-sample residuals from 2024 development evaluation only, not 2025 test outcomes; exact integer pushes represented separately. No staking recommendation. Injury/transfer/QB/weather/pace inputs not yet modeled.

readiness: Paper-only per market if 2025 fixed holdout RMSE beats the same-cohort simple scoring baseline and at least 500 eligible games are evaluated. Money-betting readiness is NOT approved by those checks or by a positive six-date sample. Report historical odds performance separately. If a market fails, show its projection as unqualified research, not a recommendation.
limitations: Historical public scores fetched now can include corrections; reconstructed point-in-time evaluation, not archived as-seen forecasts.
Offseason roster turnover and current availability are not modeled. Early-season uncertainty must be visible.
FCS and FBS coverage/sample sizes are reported. No transfer of NFL coefficients or NFL validation evidence.
Only regular-season full-game spreads and totals including overtime. No college props, moneylines or live bets.
